definitions.explanation: a condition or symptom that remains after an illness or injury has healed

examples.japanese: {後遺症|こういしょう}が{残|のこ}る。
{事故|じこ}の{後遺症|こういしょう}で{足|あし}が{不自由|ふじゆう}だ。
examples.english: Due to aftereffects from the accident, I have difficulty walking.

examples.japanese: コロナの{後遺症|こういしょう}で{倦怠感|けんたいかん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: I'm experiencing ongoing fatigue as an aftereffect of COVID.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
{後遺症|こういしょう} refers to lasting symptoms that continue after the acute phase of illness or injury.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- コロナ{後遺症|こういしょう} - long COVID
- {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}の{後遺症|こういしょう} - stroke aftereffects
- {事故|じこ}の{後遺症|こういしょう} - accident aftereffects
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}の{後遺症|こういしょう} - post-surgical effects

TYPES OF {後遺症|こういしょう}:
- {麻痺|まひ} - paralysis
- {言語障害|げんごしょうがい} - speech impairment
- {記憶障害|きおくしょうがい} - memory impairment
- {慢性|まんせい}{疲労|ひろう} - chronic fatigue

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後遺症|こういしょう}が{残|のこ}る - aftereffects remain
- {後遺症|こういしょう}に{苦|くる}しむ - suffer from aftereffects
- {後遺症|こういしょう}なく{回復|かいふく}する - recover without aftereffects
